en: Colorized view of a medieval town scene with a prominent square tower rising above a gate and adjacent roofs. An iron railing/bridge is in the foreground, with people walking along the cobbled street and trees lining the right side. Printed captions identify the place as Hermannstadt and the tower as the Ratturm. Publisher and photographer credits run vertically along the left margin. The back reads LEVELEZŐ-LAP and bears a purple collector's stamp.
